## What changed

Describe the problem, the user-visible outcome, and any related issue.

## Verification

List commands and manual checks with their results. Name the platforms or devices
you tested and identify pending checks.

## Platform, API, and release impact

Describe any permissions, signing, API contracts, or companion PRs affected.
Include the release order when another change is required.

- [ ] The PR covers one focused outcome and uses one changed file per commit.
- [ ] Test data and screenshots use synthetic values and contain no credentials or private payment details.
